title: Chord-symbol notation
description: Symbols that chord symbols use in place of ASCII spellings. Quality synonyms written in ASCII (min, -, mM7, 6/9) are spellings in qualities.json instead.

accidentals.description: Unicode accidentals and their ASCII form, applied to roots and bass notes.

qualitySymbols.description: Symbols in a chord's quality and their ASCII spelling, applied in order (so ø7 is replaced before ø). Applied only to the text after a chord's root, never to free text: Δ is also the Greek capital Delta.
